title: Run Hydroponics Advisor with fail-closed missing-data policy

gates.name: advisor-runtime-regression
gates.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/backend/plant_operations tests/backend/agent_runtime tests/backend/plant_state tests/backend/hydroponics_advisor -m "not real_model" -q

verify: The canonical hydroponics_advisor definition and strict command/request/result shapes reject caller-supplied records, refs, prompts, provider/model choice, unknown fields, and unsupported analysis values.

The assembler resolves current ActorContext normal-read authority for the same active Plant and loads at most four exact PostgreSQL records: Plant, independent latest pH/EC rows with deduplication, then remaining bounded context from the latest completed check-in and latest non-rejected Plant-state row in canonical order.

The provider request contains the project-computed 24-hour freshness object and authorized typed rows only; ActorContext, session/account/membership/grant state, UI Feed, raw chat, Timeline replay, provider history, local paths, credentials, and hidden reasoning never cross egress.
pH and EC freshness are independent and use the exact closed interval; boundary-age values are fresh, older or missing values are explicit, and future-dated values are stale.

Any non-empty missing/stale set accepts only the exact structured measurement request and deterministic project wording, maps to one pending non-consumable task_request MessageEnvelope, and creates no classification, task, Safety, Bus/UI, Plant-state, approval, or action effect.

Recommendation, hypothesis, clarification, or model silence is rejected while pH or EC is missing/stale. With both fresh, candidate refs include both authoritative measurement refs and model text remains opaque pending data with no direct authority.
Post-model session/membership/grant/active-Plant and audit-failure semantics match Agent Runtime; archive/revoke blocks handoff and restore does not replay it.
DeepSeek/Gemini composition uses exactly one explicit binding with no default, fake, or cross-provider fallback; chatgpt_oauth remains fail closed and all evidence is redacted.

A non-skipped credentialed canonical-agent smoke invokes exactly one real provider over the missing/stale fixture and returns audited envelope_ready with the exact pending measurement task request; every skip, substitute, non-request model decision, blocked/failed/unaudited result, or direct downstream effect fails acceptance.
evidence_required: exact advisor command request result policy and envelope contract tests
PostgreSQL input order freshness boundary and forbidden-source evidence
missing/stale measurement-request mapping and zero-direct-effect evidence
fresh-evidence pending-only and physical-action bypass prevention evidence
current authorization archive revoke and audit-failure race evidence
DeepSeek/Gemini explicit binding and no-fake no-fallback anti-cheat inspection
non-skipped canonical hydroponics_advisor real-provider missing-data smoke
focused and full deterministic test summaries
purpose: Add the canonical Hydroponics Advisor product-agent path that evaluates current authorized pH/EC and Plant-state evidence, requests unavailable critical measurements without invention, and preserves the project-owned pending Safety/task boundary.
success_outcome: One explicitly bound real Hydroponics Advisor consumes only current authorized PostgreSQL evidence; missing or stale pH/EC yields exactly one audited pending measurement task request with project-owned wording, while fresh-evidence advice remains pending opaque candidate data and no invalid, unauthorized, archived, fake, fallback, failed, or unaudited branch can create a task, publish content, clear Safety, confirm Plant state, approve or execute an action.
anti_goals: No Safety classifier, Safety Gate decision, ordinary or action task persistence, approval/follow-up, Bus/UI publication, Plant-state mutation, frontend, or automated actuation implementation.

No public prompt/model/advisor HTTP endpoint, background worker, outbox, table/migration, provider history, Agno memory/RAG/tools/Team, sensor ingestion, crop recipe, target range, nutrient schedule, or dosage formula.
No default model, cross-provider fallback, fake/canned product output, caller-supplied context/refs/prompts, or secret/raw provider evidence.

forbidden_scope: FT-004 measurement persistence/freshness contract changes or FT-009 Plant-state lifecycle/evidence changes
FT-011 classifier/Safety approval, FT-012 task/approval/follow-up, FT-008 Bus/UI, FT-016 frontend, governance, dataset, sensor, or automated actuation implementation
public prompt/model API, background worker/outbox, new persistence, provider history/raw response storage, default model, fallback, or fake/canned product output
secrets, auth/session material, local paths, UI/raw chat, Timeline replay, provider payloads, prompts, candidate text evidence, or hidden reasoning
stop_conditions: TASK-035 is not done or the classified Plant-state input contract differs materially from the linked canonical spec.
Correctness would require widening the generic Agent Runtime outcome/MessageEnvelope authority or changing canonical Plant Operations freshness.
A missing/stale branch cannot be made deterministic without model-authored values, wording, task kind, or action semantics.
Current authorization and active-Plant state cannot be rechecked after provider I/O before handoff.
A passing product-agent smoke would require skip, fake/canned executor, fallback, missing audit, or exposing provider/auth/prompt data.

constraints: Use exactly the internally assembled PostgreSQL records and project-computed freshness object; callers cannot supply context, records, refs, prompts, model, or schema.
Require both pH and EC fresh for analysis before recommendation, hypothesis, or clarification; a non-empty missing/stale set accepts only the exact project-owned measurement request mapping.
Every non-silent output stops at the existing pending MessageEnvelope; persist, publish, classify, approve, or execute nothing in this task.
invariants: PostgreSQL Plant Operations and classified Plant-state rows are evidence authority; Timeline, UI Feed, raw chat, MessageEnvelope, and model text are not.
Missing/stale evidence is explicit and cannot become invented advice; fresh evidence never bypasses project-owned classification, Safety Gate, or human approval.
Measurement requests can become only ordinary FT-012 tasks after matching classification and current guards; FT-010 can never create or request action_task.
Archive/revoke/audit failure blocks handoff and restore never replays prior work.
verification_targets: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/backend/plant_operations tests/backend/agent_runtime tests/backend/plant_state tests/backend/hydroponics_advisor -m "not real_model" -q
The credentialed missing/stale fixture proves one real provider call, exact policy request, audited pending task_request envelope, and zero direct task/Safety/Bus/UI/state/action effect.
